opportunities.name: Tech lead research: HN + GitHub + note
opportunities.description: For a given project name, search Hacker News (HN/Algolia) for top story, search GitHub for the repo and read stars/last release, then save a 'Lead:' note with the combined info.
steps: Search the project name on Hacker News (Algolia search box)
Note the top story title, points and age
Open GitHub search, type the project name, press Enter
Click the matching repo link and read stars and last release date
Open Notes, click New note, type 'Lead: <name>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>' and press Enter
